pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gandhabādhipubbaṃ anuvattati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.3: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gandhabādhipubbaṃ anuvattissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ gandhabādhipubbaṃ anuvattatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.8: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ gandhabādhipubbaṃ anuvattissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.11.1: yā pana bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaraṃ appaṭikāraṃ akatasahāyaṃ tamanuvatteyya sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi evamassa vacanīyā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.12: eso kho ayye bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena ukkhitto dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaro appaṭikāro akatasahāyo māyye etaṃ bhikkhuṃ anuvattīti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.13: evañca sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tatheva paggaṇheyya sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.14: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyya iccetaṃ kusalaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.15: no ce paṭinissajjeyya ayampi pārājikā hoti asaṃvāsā ukkhittānuvattikāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.8: āpattiyā adassane vā appaṭikamme vā appaṭinissagge vā ukkhitto.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.14: saṅghaṃ vā puggalaṃ vā kammaṃ vā nādiyati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.19: so tehi saddhiṃ natthi tena vuccati akatasahāyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.21: yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko sāpi taṃdiṭṭhikā hoti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.25: aññāhi bhikkhunīhi. yā passanti yā suṇanti tāhi vattabbā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.26: eso kho ayye bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena ukkhitto dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaro appaṭikāro akatasahāyo
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.34: eso kho ayye bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena ukkhitto dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaro appaṭikāro akatasahāyo
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.44: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaraṃ appaṭikāraṃ akatasahāyaṃ tamanuvattati sā taṃ vatthuṃ nappaṭinissajjati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.45: yadi saṅghassa pattakaslaṃ saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.48: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaraṃ appaṭikāraṃ akatasahāyaṃ tamanuvattati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.50: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.51: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā samanubhāsanā tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya sā tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.55: samanubhaṭṭhā saṅghena itthannāmā bhikkhunī tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.56: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.63: seyyathāpi nāma puthusilā dvedhā bhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti evameva bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsiyamānā appaṭinissajjantī assamaṇī hoti asakyadhītā tena vuccati pārājikā hotīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.65: saṃvāso nāma ekakammaṃ ekuddeso samasikkhātā eso saṃvāso nāma
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.66: so tāya saddhiṃ natthi tena vuccati asaṃvāsāti.
